plot-caption: For each adjective asked of a 'place': the words that the three models hold about it with no image (the no-image readout at the adjective, minus the mean of the seven adjectives), and the words of the scene that go with a yes or a no (r over 197 NTAs of the readout at 'place' with the expected answer). Each word is ranked by its lowest z-score over Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B, at relative depth .25 to .75. The adjective and its forms are left out. Embedded: the top-100 words at the adjective that are also in the no-image top 100.
